simple.summary: חֲסִין (chăçîyn) means properly, firm , i.e. (by implication) mighty First listed occurrence: Ps 89 9.

definitions.full: H2626. chasin חֲסִין adjective strong, mighty (Aramaism); — only יָהּ חֲסִין מִיכָֿמוֺךָ Psa 89:9 .
